hypotheses.justification: Split on whether G is locally compact. In the positive case, install the instance and use the existing proof. Otherwise, the guard in HaarQuotient.weight must be false: a topological group is regular (IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace), hence R₁, and WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace.locallyCompactSpace would imply local compactness. Thus weight and density are identically zero; ENNReal.zero_div handles even the zero denominator. Both integrals are therefore zero, for arbitrary f and μ.

The remaining assumptions imply this instance. Local compactness and second countability make G sigma-compact; hH.sigmaCompactSpace then makes H sigma-compact. IsHaarMeasure supplies IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μH, so SigmaFinite.of_isFiniteMeasureOnCompacts gives SigmaFinite μH and the standard instance gives SFinite μH. Install these instances and retain the existing proof. This argument also covers trivial groups.
